rationale: The two solutions are very close: both map numbers to words, handle the singular case, capitalize the opening word and join verses with blank lines. A has slightly better structure. It splits the work into verse, verseLine and bottles, so Recite stays a simple loop and the repeated opening line is built by one helper instead of being written out twice inline. B puts the whole verse construction inside Recite and repeats the same Sprintf for the first two lines. In B's favour, it has doc comments and its title helper is rune-safe, while A has no comments. Those are minor here because all the text is ASCII. Overall A's decomposition makes it marginally more readable.
